description: This file defines the NotificationsActivity class for the Android frontend of a Kotlin-based online shopping platform. It manages the notifications UI, including displaying notifications, toggling demo mode, and providing a developer menu for generating demo notifications or clearing notifications.

classes.name: NotificationsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class managing the notifications screen, demo toggle, and developer menu for generating demo notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, observer, adapter, and demo toggle.

methods.name: setupDemoToggle
methods.description: Configures the demo mode switch to enable or disable demo notifications.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and sets long-press listener for the notification bell icon.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including back navigation and long-press behavior.

methods.name: showDevMenu
methods.description: Displays a developer menu to generate specific demo notifications or clear notifications.
